preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each of n0, n1, and n2 must be between 0 and 100.
The sum of n0, n1, and n2 must be greater than 0.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly t lines, one for each test case.
Each output line must contain at least one character.

postconditions.expression: all(line in {'0', '1'} for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line must consist only of '0' and '1' characters.
